notes.title: DEMO V2.0 Update now available.
notes.content:
[u][b]The Grove: Nostalgia's End DEMO has been updated to version 2.0[/b][/u]

It's a very small update and should be ready for you on next login if you have the game in your library already. 

[i]PATCH NOTES:[/i]

-Fixed a game breaking bug in the back room of inverse that would lock the game.
-Several clipping issues around Vapor City have been fixed.
-Some general grammatical updates and fixes.
-Certain enemies have had their health pools adjusted and behavioral and speed updates to increase combat pacing.
-Enemies now drop slightly more currency when defeated.
-Your party now fully heals upon leveling up.
-More treasure hidden over on the West Side of the city.
-A few maps have had their artwork updated to be more interesting and beautiful.

I hope you are enjoying the demo so far and I can't thank all of you enough for showing
me love and giving feedback. I hope you all have a fantastic March, and I'll be back soon
with more updates.

If you want to follow my development closer, you can follow me on Twitter at:  https://bit.ly/3BbJ0On

notes.title: GROVE: Nostalgia's End Development update 2022
notes.content:
Hey there!
First off I want to say thank you for taking the time to stop by and check out GROVE!
My name is James, I'm the solo developer of GROVE: Nostalgia's End. While I've been buried in
my screen for months now, this little love letter to retro gaming nostalgia has been brought to life.
If you are a fan of the 16 and 32 bit golden era of RPG games, or just love story driven turn based adventures, I hope you will have some fun in the world of GROVE.

I wanted to take a little time and discuss the timeline and my plans for the continued development of
the game. I work as a full time musician aside from developing the game, and, as the world is slowly starting to open back up for travel and performance, I will be develop when I am at home. 
Currently at the time of writing this, around 8-9 hours of story have been coded into the game, my
end plan is to shoot for total play time to be between 30-40 hours to have the proper time to take the characters on this crazy adventure.

This week I've released the first early beta demo of the game.
This includes the entire first chapter's story, as well as several side diversions, I hope you'll enjoy your time in Vapor City and discovering the world of GROVE: Nostalgia's End.
